cd /app/tmp/t && cat > mkbig2.py <<'EOF'
import json, sys, random
mode=sys.argv[1]
if mode=="audit_states":
    P=8; R=3; D=32
    inp=[[[r+q for i in range(D)] for q in range(R)] for r in range(P)]
    exp=[]
    for q in range(R):
        exp.append([sum(inp[r][q][i] for r in range(P)) for i in range(D)])
    n=12000
    states=[]
    for i in range(n):
        dl=[[exp[q] for q in range(R)] for r in range(P)]
        sl=[{"seq":q,"ranks":[0,1,2],"sum":[sum(inp[r][q][j] for r in [0,1,2]) for j in range(D)]} for q in range(R)]
        states.append({"delivered":dl,"slots":sl})
    fair=[{"action":"a","mode":"strong"},{"action":"b","mode":"weak"}]
    edges=[]
    for i in range(n-1): edges.append([i,"a",i+1])
    for i in range(n-1): edges.append([i,"b",i])
    edges.append([n-1,"a",0])
    req={"op":"audit","inputs":inp,"start":0,"edges":edges,"states":states,"fairness":fair}
elif mode=="replay_heavy":
    P=4; R=8; D=1
    inp=[[[q+1] for q in range(R)] for r in range(P)]
    events=[]
    # many sends and deliveries alternating
    nid=0
    pend=set()
    while len(events)<19990:
        events.append(["send",len(events)%P, (len(events)//4)%R])
        events.append(["deliver", 0])   # mostly missing
    for i in range(9):
        events.append(["deliver",i])
        events.append(["retry",i%P])
    req={"op":"replay","inputs":inp,"slots":16,"window":8,"events":events}
import sys
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(req)+"\n")
EOF
